answer_1.quote: We experiment on two NLG tasks, i.e., abstractive text summarization and question generation to evaluate our LAFT for cross-lingual transfer.

answer_2.quote: Experimental results show that the proposed method facilitates a better and parameter-efficient transferability on abstractive summarization (+up to 0.71 ROUGE-L) and question generation (+up to 2.45 ROUGE-L)
